mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 66 degrees with clear skies by Reddan Soccer Park and a New Moon phase.
The City of Verona has announced that road construction begins August 18 on Highway M, while the Senior Center is seeking volunteers for their community programs.
Today you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company, while tomorrow features the Dane County Farmers' Market and music at Paddy Mac's.
In a notable call from last week, on August 5, police arrested a 37-year-old Madison man on Whalen Road following a probation violation warrant.
The flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently closed, but they will open at 10 AM today.
